strings.tagline: Calm daily exercises for memory, attention and planning.
strings.welcome_text: A few minutes a day of gentle exercises. There is no clock and no way to lose.
strings.name_invalid: Please write a first name, with letters only.
strings.session_text: About 10 minutes: memory, attention and planning, taking turns.
strings.shopping_wrong: Not quite. The things on the list are marked.
strings.odd_wrong: Not quite. The different one is marked.
strings.pairs_wrong: All pairs found. Next time, try to remember where each picture was.
strings.sequences_wrong: Not quite. The right order is numbered on the tiles.
strings.trail_wrong: All joined up. Next time, look for the next one before you tap.
strings.trail_misses: {count} taps were not the next one.
strings.steps_wrong: Not quite. The right order is numbered.
strings.summary_same: The same level as last time
strings.summary_down: Level {previous} last time: some days are like that
strings.summary_first: Your first time: a good start
strings.summary_note: Tomorrow the exercises start where you left off.
strings.disclaimer: MindKeep is for exercise, not a medical treatment.
